stem.text: Skaters of masses $80\,\text{kg}$ and $40\,\text{kg}$ move directly towards each other and collide.
Before the collision, the heavier skater is moving to the right at a speed of $2.0\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ and the lighter skater is moving to the left at a speed of $1.0\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
After the collision, the heavier skater moves to the right at a speed of $0.80\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
What is the relative speed of separation of the two skaters?
